title: AudienceCircleMembership
description: One account's relation to one audience circle. The top level describes the canonical PostgreSQL record (domain_audience_circle_members, primary key circle_id + account_id). Only status active in a circle with state active confers content rights (weltgewebe_active_circle_member). Same address or map position never confers membership. Declining, withdrawing or leaving deletes the row; there is no declined or left status.

invited_by_account_id.description: Inviting account. The founder's own row names the founder. NULL after the inviter's account is deleted.

created_at.description: Creation instant of this row. For a pending invitation it is the invitation revision that accept, decline and withdraw compare against.

joined_at.description: Set exactly when status is active (database CHECK).

member.description: What one active member may see about another: the account id and the account title, nothing else. No status, inviter, join time, role, e-mail or location. The account id is the same identifier used to invite or to open a direct conversation.

member_list.description: GET /api/circles/{id}/members. Returned only to a non-disabled active member of an active circle; everyone else, including invited accounts, gets 404. Lists every active, non-disabled member (the reader included), ordered by title then account_id. Pending invitations are never listed. The list is not paginated and has no upper bound.
